hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer value-line color raster smoke
hardware.tested_state: rebuilt and reflashed after mapping trusted-review Value body-line styles to a dedicated yellow raster color

procedure: Sourced /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell used for build, flash, and smoke.
Verified ESP-IDF v5.5.4 before running firmware commands.
Built firmware revision 2f21b3b with ESP-IDF v5.5.4; the app binary size was 0x8ea40 bytes with 0x715c0 bytes free.
Flashed the firmware to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified bootloader, app, and partition-table hashes during the ESP-IDF flash operation.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-capabilities after the flash.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-review-scenarios after the flash.
expected_result: The current firmware image should still answer protocol requests deterministically, keep sign_event disabled, and run the review-scenario smoke after the T-Display S3 raster maps Value lines to yellow.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built clean app version 2f21b3b with binary size 0x8ea40 and 0x715c0 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The capability smoke passed with 40 verified exchanges, 9 response frames, and 31 expected rejection frames. The review-scenario smoke passed with 7 scenarios, 8 verified exchanges, 7 response frames, and 1 expected rejection frame. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: This report validates post-flash USB serial protocol behavior and non-interactive review-scenario routing for the current ESP32 commit.
Host-core raster tests verify that Value body-line pixels resolve to the dedicated yellow color, but this report does not include human visual confirmation of the yellow color on the physical panel.
It is not a camera test, QR flow test, key provisioning test, storage test, secure-boot test, debug-lock test, or real signing test.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, full Unicode review rendering acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, companion signed-output verification for real signatures, or production signing readiness.
sign_event remains signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
